```{r}
table(euroleague_basketball$Country) %>% sort()
```
How do arena capacities compare across teams and countries? In R, the readr::parse_number() function might be helpful here.

```{r}
euroleague_basketball <- euroleague_basketball %>%
  mutate(Capacity = str_squish(Capacity)) %>%
  mutate(
    # extract all numeric values from the string
    Capacities = str_extract_all(Capacity, "\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Capacity_old = parse_number(sapply(Capacities, `[`, 1)),
    Capacity_new = parse_number(sapply(Capacities, `[`, 2)),
    arena_capacity_high = pmax(Capacity_old, Capacity_new, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  select(-Capacities)

#By country

euroleague_basketball %>%
  group_by(Country) %>%
  summarise(mean_capacity = mean(arena_capacity_high, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Country, mean_capacity), y = mean_capacity, fill = Country)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Country", y = "Average Arena Capacity", fill = "")

euroleague_basketball %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = arena_capacity_high, fill = Country)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 15, alpha = 0.7, color = "white") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Arena Capacity", y = "Count")

euroleague_basketball %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Country, 
             y = arena_capacity_high, 
             fill = Arena,    # each arena gets its own color
             group = Arena)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Country",
    y = "Arena Capacity",
    fill = "Arena",
    title = "Arena Capacities by Country"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )


```


Which clubs have been the most successful historically?

```{r}
titles <- euroleague_basketball %>% select(Team, Titles_Won) %>% column_to_rownames(var = "Team") %>% arrange(desc(Titles_Won))
final_four <- euroleague_basketball %>% select(Team, FinalFour_Appearances) %>% column_to_rownames(var = "Team")
final_four$FinalFour_Appearances <- as.numeric(final_four$FinalFour_Appearances)
final_four <- final_four %>% arrange(desc(FinalFour_Appearances))

print(titles)
print(final_four)

#If you needed to convert the years into individual numbers
euroleague_basketball <- euroleague_basketball %>%
  mutate(
    Titles_Won = case_when(
      is.na(Years_of_Titles_Won) | str_trim(Years_of_Titles_Won) == "" ~ 0L,
      str_detect(Years_of_Titles_Won, regex("none", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ str_count(Years_of_Titles_Won, "\\d{4}")
    )
  )

colnames(final_four)
```
